admission.justification: A marker must not hide a real finding; the rule keeps every exemption visible and reasoned while dropping only its own kind on the lines it covers.

applicability: Every documentation-check marker comment in a public document.
conditions: A marker drops every finding of its kind on the line it covers, or on every line of the fenced block it opens.
Only the kinds path and identifier exist.
A marker without a reason, of an unknown kind, or with nothing to allow is itself a finding.
exclusions: Ordinary comments that are not documentation-check markers.
statement: A marker allows every finding of its kind on the lines it covers: its own line and, when it stands alone on its line, the next line or the fenced block that the next line opens. Only the kinds path and identifier exist, and a marker without a reason, of an unknown kind or with nothing to allow is itself a finding.
